issues.detail: The skill does not cover error handling for many operations and lacks examples for replication, access policies, and event notifications.

scenarios.name: create-versioned-bucket-with-lifecycle
scenarios.rationale: Both responses use the required PutBucketVersioningCommand and PutBucketLifecycleConfigurationCommand, but each also includes an additional command (CreateBucketCommand in A, create-bucket in B) and B adds an extra lifecycle rule, so A is closer to the rubric.

scenarios.name: generate-presigned-upload-url-with-cors
scenarios.rationale: B meets all rubric requirements while A misses MaxAgeSeconds and uses a different signing method.

scenarios.name: multipart-upload-large-file-with-progress
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies the rubric, while Response B does not use @aws-sdk/lib-storage and thus fails to meet the requirements.
